articles.summary: Superior Energy agreed to acquire Welltec International, a robotic well-intervention and completions company, expanding its oilfield services portfolio and offshore reach.
articles.why_it_matters: Oilfield-services M&A with no homebuilder, land or builder-finance angle; noise for Domain.

articles.summary: Tony Avila (Builder Advisor Group, Avila Real Estate Capital) says patient-capital lot sellers can hold out while builders underwrite at lower margins; bank AD&C lending is ~$90B vs $200B+ in 2006, with private land capital filling the gap.
articles.why_it_matters: Describes a widening gap between lot-seller pricing and builder underwriting and names a private debt fund (AREC, backed by ~15 builders) competing to fund lots, which bears on Domain's option pricing and competing capital.

articles.drop: executive profile page on MarketScreener, not a news story

articles.summary: HousingWire profile of Taylor Morrison's CEO on trust as a brand value, citing the builder's ranking as most trusted homebuilder on Time's 2026 list.
articles.why_it_matters: Brand and award commentary from a top-10 builder with nothing on land appetite or financing that would change how Domain approaches Taylor Morrison.

articles.summary: Moody's left France's sovereign credit rating unchanged on October 23, 2026, while warning about political fragmentation and rising borrowing costs.
articles.why_it_matters: French sovereign rating news with no US builder or land-finance link; noise for Domain.

articles.summary: Moody's kept France's credit rating unchanged despite rising debt and political fragmentation.
articles.why_it_matters: French sovereign rating news with no US builder or land-finance link; noise for Domain.

articles.summary: Moody's held France at Aa3 with a negative outlook on October 23, 2026, citing political fragmentation and higher yields.
articles.why_it_matters: European sovereign rating action with at most a remote effect on US Treasury yields; nothing Domain would act on.

articles.summary: MarketWatch preview of Moody's October 2026 review of France's rating and how French debt turmoil fed into US Treasury yields.
articles.why_it_matters: Sovereign-rating preview with only a loose Treasury-yield link to builder funding costs; noise for Domain.

articles.summary: D.R. Horton signed a multiyear deal with Canadian firm Promise Robotics to build more than 1,250 homes using its AI-powered factory production.
articles.why_it_matters: A construction-method pilot at the largest builder; it does not change D.R. Horton's land appetite or financing needs in a way Domain would act on.

articles.summary: Rosenberg, Texas, City Council voted 4-3 in September 2026 to reject a proposed agreement for a 670-home KB Home development, objecting to small lot sizes.
articles.why_it_matters: Local pushback on small-lot entitlements can stall KB Home's Houston-area lot pipeline, which matters if Domain is underwriting small-lot Texas projects.

articles.summary: Thryv agreed to sell its print yellow-pages business for $142 million.
articles.why_it_matters: Marketing-services divestiture unrelated to homebuilding or land; noise for Domain.

articles.summary: PCL Construction, a Canadian general contractor, appointed Danny Dodds as chief financial officer effective immediately.
articles.why_it_matters: A CFO change at a commercial contractor, not a homebuilder customer; no relevance to Domain.

articles.summary: Bisnow reports Dallas-Fort Worth industrial development is spreading beyond core submarkets as developers seek cheaper land.
articles.why_it_matters: Industrial land competition on the DFW fringe could compete with residential land, but the story has no builder or residential lot angle for Domain.

articles.summary: Home Depot named CFO Richard McPhail to succeed Ted Decker as CEO and reported third-quarter 2026 results.
articles.why_it_matters: A leadership change at a home-improvement retailer, not a builder or capital provider; no action for Domain.

articles.summary: Home Depot named CFO Richard McPhail CEO effective November 23, 2026; Ted Decker steps down as CEO and stays Chair.
articles.why_it_matters: A leadership change at a home-improvement retailer, not a builder or capital provider; no action for Domain.

articles.summary: Home Depot CEO Ted Decker is stepping down after a medical leave; CFO Richard McPhail succeeds him as CEO, announced November 17, 2026.
articles.why_it_matters: A leadership change at a home-improvement retailer, not a builder or capital provider; no action for Domain.

articles.summary: Home Depot appointed Jordan Broggi, a 13-year company veteran, as CFO effective November 23, 2026, replacing Richard McPhail, who becomes CEO.
articles.why_it_matters: A CFO change at a home-improvement retailer, not a homebuilder; nothing for Domain to act on.

articles.summary: NAHB: custom homes were 19.6% of single-family starts in 2025, up from 17.5% in 2024.
articles.why_it_matters: A rising custom share means production builders, Domain's customers, took a smaller slice of 2025 starts; useful background, nothing to act on.

articles.summary: KB Home said Albert Z. Praw, EVP of Real Estate and Business Development for 30+ years, retires November 30, 2026; no successor named. He is expected to advise on land relationships and transactions for up to a year.
articles.why_it_matters: KB Home's long-time land deal-maker is leaving with no named successor, so Domain should call KB Home now to learn who will own land and option relationships, and keep Praw's advisory role in mind.

suggested_update.text: Albert Z. Praw retires as EVP, Real Estate and Business Development, effective November 30, 2026 (announced November 16, 2026); no successor named; he is expected to advise on land relationships and transactions for up to one year.

articles.summary: Sekisui House Ltd., the Japanese parent of Sekisui House U.S., announced a tender offer for a Gifu-based landscape architecture firm.
articles.why_it_matters: A small domestic Japanese acquisition by the parent company; it does not change Sekisui House U.S.'s land or financing needs.
